summary.summary: Final-year Computer Science student (B.Tech, GITAM University, 2026) and  Grand Champion of the ET GenAI Hackathon 2026  — winner of the national 1st prize among 50,000+ participants. Builder of production-grade AI, full-stack, and event-driven systems using Python, Java, and modern AI frameworks (PyTorch, LangGraph, RAG). IEEE-published author and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure certified. Strong record of leading teams, shipping working prototypes, and translating research into impact.

bullets.text: Led a team of 3 to build an AI Image Super-Resolution pipeline using PyTorch and TensorFlow on the DIV2K dataset, applying knowledge distillation from a teacher CNN to a 483K-parameter student model.
Achieved 92.7% SSIM and 28.5 dB PSNR with real-time 1920×1080 inference, balancing accuracy against latency and parameter count.
Owned the full delivery cycle — preprocessing, training, benchmarking, and stakeholder demos — in Agile sprints with Intel mentors.
Maintained reproducible experiments and full GitHub documentation for fast iteration on architecture and loss-function changes.

projects.name: AgriBloom Agentic — AI Advisory for Indian Farmers

bullets.text: Built a 5-agent LangGraph pipeline (Orchestrator → Vision → Knowledge → Compliance → Output) that takes a crop photo and returns disease diagnosis with treatment in 10 Indian languages.
Trained an EfficientNet-B4 classifier on 91,000+ images across 92 disease classes; added a Gemini Vision fallback for any crop outside the trained set.
Implemented a deterministic compliance engine that blocks 46 CIB&RC-banned pesticides and enforces FSSAI MRL limits, with a full audit trail per check.
Integrated an ICAR-grounded RAG knowledge base in ChromaDB for advisory retrieval, plus a fertilizer NPK calculator, KVK helpline finder, and voice/PDF report output.
Built a production-grade SaaS platform providing ZKP authentication via REST API — Schnorr proofs on secp256k1 with sub-5ms verification, no blockchain required.

Developed full-stack infrastructure: FastAPI backend with 8 SQLAlchemy models, React developer dashboard (11 pages), Celery for async batch processing, and JavaScript + Python SDKs for 3-line client integration.
Shipped with 37 passing tests, Alembic migrations, Docker Compose deployment (API + PostgreSQL + Redis + Celery), and CI/CD via GitHub Actions — basis for the IEEE conference publication.
Engineered a hybrid forecasting engine (EMA + Linear Regression + LSTM-inspired) processing 10,000+ metrics, delivering 40% simulated cost reduction via intelligent auto-scaling.
Implemented Pinecone vector search with 8-dimensional workload embeddings and cosine similarity for workload pattern classification.
Shipped a full-stack platform with 10 RESTful APIs, real-time dashboard, and one-command Docker deployment.
